2. Configure IP addresses on the appropriate interfaces/subinterfaces
3. Set up routing between router1 and router2 — either via a routing protocol (OSPF/BGP/IS-IS) or static routes (e.g., static route for 192.168.1.0/24 on router2 pointing to router1, and vice versa)
4. Configure switch1 and switch2 appropriately (likely as L2 bridges if the routers handle L3)
